BillHeading.BriefDescription: Naming a medical school at Washington State University after Elson S. Floyd.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to naming a school of medicine at Washington State University after Elson S. Floyd; and amending RCW 28B.30.---.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28B.30.--- and 2015 c 6 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Major lines common to University of Washington and Washington State University.
BillSection.P: The board of regents of Washington State University may offer and teach medicine as a major line, and is authorized to establish, operate, and maintain a school of medicine at the university, to be known as the Elson S. Floyd School of Medicine. The board of regents of Washington State University may offer and teach forestry as a major line.
